title: Adjacent Increases
statement: Implement `solve(items)`. Return how many adjacent pairs have a strictly greater second value. A list shorter than 2 returns 0.
hints: zip of the list with its tail is the pair view.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: pairwise, or zip(items, items[1:]), walks neighbors without a manual index.

editorial: pairwise, or zip(items, items[1:]), walks neighbors without a manual index. The count is the number of rises. A non-strict comparison would count plateaus, which this series does not want.
reference_solution:
def solve(items):
    return sum(1 for left, right in zip(items, items[1:]) if right > left)
